<translate>
<!--T:4-->
'''Goku''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku's House|Goku's House]] in the plains of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], together with [[Special:MyLanguage/Gohan|Gohan]]. He teaches Fly, Instant Transmission and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fusion Dance|Fusion Dance]], the Kamehameha and the Spirit Bomb, and four strike techniques. He only trains Good-aligned players.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location == <!--T:5-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
Goku lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku's House|Goku's House]], which generates once per world in a plains biome. Capsule Corp Assistants sell a map to it at trade tier 1 (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku's House#Finding it|Goku's House]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Alignment == <!--T:7-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:8-->
Goku needs an [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] of '''61 or higher''' (Good). Below that he still talks to you, but his '''Skills''', '''Train''' and new quests stay locked.
</translate>

<translate>
== Skills and techniques == <!--T:9-->
</translate>
{{See also|Skills|Techniques}}
<translate>
<!--T:10-->
* '''Skills:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Fly|Fly]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Instant Transmission|Instant Transmission]], Fusion (the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fusion Dance|Fusion Dance]])
* '''Ki attacks:''' Kamehameha, Spirit Bomb
* '''Strike attacks:''' Dragon Fist, Super God Fist, Oozaru Fist, Beam Sword Slash (16,000 TP)
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:11-->
Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill. His '''Train''' option spawns a Shadow Clone to spar with.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:12-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:13-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quest 52, ''End of the Tournament'': find Goku's House and talk to Goku.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Android Saga|Android Saga]] quest 17, ''Heart Virus Medicine'': give Goku 8 Glistering Melon Slices.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Daima Saga|Daima Saga]] quest 2, ''Gomah's Wish'': find Goku's House and talk to Goku.
</translate>

<translate>
== As a tournament fighter == <!--T:15-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:16-->
Goku also fights in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|tournaments]], as NPC fighters separate from the master:
* '''Goku (Mid)''' and '''Goku (Mid, Super Saiyan)''' can be drawn as contenders in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Games|Cell Games]]. A bracket has at most one of them.
* '''Goku (End, Super Saiyan)''', with a halo, is the finalist of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]]. The other Goku (End) forms (base, Super Saiyan 2 and Super Saiyan 3) are in its contender pool too, but the finalist takes Goku's place first, so they are never drawn.
* His fusions with [[Special:MyLanguage/Vegeta|Vegeta]] fight in the Otherworld Tournament too: [[Special:MyLanguage/Gogeta|Gogeta]] (by the Fusion Dance) is its champion, and [[Special:MyLanguage/Vegetto|Vegetto]] (by the Potara Earrings) can be drawn as a contender.
* The young Goku of the Classic Saga is [[Special:MyLanguage/Kid Goku|Kid Goku]], the champion of [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament|Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament]].
* In the [[Special:MyLanguage/World Martial Arts Tournament|World Martial Arts Tournament]], '''Goku''' (as he fights in the Classic Saga's last tournament), '''Goku (End)''' and '''Goku (GT)''' can be drawn as contenders, as well as Kid Goku. The four count as different characters, so they can meet in the same bracket.
</translate>
